enrichment.headline: Ratifies $54,158 for School Services of California to lobby and track legislation in Sacramento

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $54,158.00

enrichment.summary: School Services of California, based in Sacramento, will work to protect and advance the District's interests with state lawmakers and the state administration. It will develop strategies, monitor legislation, lobby, and set up meetings for Board members and District staff who travel to Sacramento. The contract covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, and the Board is approving it after the start date.
